notes: three routes: the two heads أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة and محمد بن بشار (قالا) meet at the teacher محمد بن جعفر، غندر (the laqab غندر is kept with the name); the third branch is أحمد بن سعيد الدارمي through النضر بن شميل; all meet at شعبة, whose tail is shared; the narrator's parenthesis «وما أدركت رجلا منا به شبيها» is not a name; Sa'd b. Zurara is the subject of the story, not a transmitter; the matn begins at the illness account; offsets approximate
